title: Serverless and Azure Functions
description: Build event-driven applications with Azure Functions, triggers, bindings, Durable Functions, and local development workflows.
longDescription: This module teaches serverless development on Azure. You will learn how to create Functions apps, use triggers and bindings, handle HTTP and storage events, apply dependency injection, configure scaling, and build long-running workflows with Durable Functions.
whatYouLearn: Create and run Azure Functions locally and in Azure
Connect Functions to storage queues and timers
Design durable orchestrations with Durable Functions
